title: Vendor
wikitext:
= Overview =

Any [[NPC]] who buys and sells [[item]]s. [[Trainer]]s are not technically vendors, even though they sell [[recipe]]s, since they do not buy anything.

Also sometimes used as a verb for selling to a vendor, as in, "I'm just going to ''vendor'' this axe, since I can't use it."


== Types of Vendors ==
* General Goods
* Trade Supplies
* Armor
* Weapon
* Blacksmithing Supplies
* Fishing Supplies
